words.ex_en: Rachel got flustered when the café filled up.

words.def_en: cute or romantic in a way that feels corny
words.ex_en: Joey's pickup line was so cheesy.

words.def_en: not aware of what is happening around you
words.ex_en: Ross was oblivious to Rachel's hints.
words.ex_ko: 로스는 레이첼의 힌트를 전혀 눈치채지 못했다.
words.scene_ko: 로스가 주변 분위기를 못 읽는 상황

words.ex_en: Phoebe looked bewildered by Chandler's joke.
Monica was mortified when everyone heard her.
words.ex_ko: 모니카는 모두가 자기 말을 들어서 몹시 창피했다.

words.ex_en: Ross worried he was being too clingy.
words.ex_ko: 로스는 자기가 너무 집착하는 건 아닌지 걱정했다.
words.scene_ko: 연애 초반 너무 붙어 다니는 상황

words.ex_en: Joey was stoked about the free pizza.

words.def_en: caring too much about small unimportant things
words.ex_en: Don't be petty, Chandler. Just share it.
words.ex_ko: 쪼잔하게 굴지 마, 챈들러. 그냥 나눠 먹어.

words.ex_en: Monica looked smug after winning again.
words.ex_ko: 모니카는 또 이기고 나서 의기양양해 보였다.

words.def_en: to leave or get rid of someone or something
words.ex_en: Did you ditch me for Joey's party?
words.ex_ko: 조이 파티 때문에 나를 버리고 간 거야?
words.scene_ko: 약속을 깨고 다른 곳으로 가 버린 상황

idioms.def_en: to stay up all night to finish something
idioms.ex_en: Ross pulled an all-nighter for his lecture.
idioms.scene_ko: 로스가 일 때문에 밤을 새우는 상황

idioms.def_en: from the very beginning, without using ready-made parts
idioms.ex_en: Monica made the sauce from scratch.
Chandler felt like he was in a rut.
idioms.ex_ko: 챈들러는 쳇바퀴 같은 일상에 빠진 기분이었다.
idioms.scene_ko: 챈들러가 지루한 직장 생활을 푸념하는 상황

idioms.def_en: to be forced to answer or decide suddenly
idioms.ex_en: Phoebe felt put on the spot by Rachel.

idioms.def_en: to act calm and not show your feelings
idioms.ex_en: Just play it cool when she walks in.
idioms.scene_ko: 좋아하는 사람 앞에서 태연한 척하는 상황

idioms.def_en: to reach the lowest possible point
idioms.ex_en: Joey hit rock bottom after the failed audition.

idioms.def_en: to work late into the night
idioms.ex_en: Rachel burned the midnight oil on her résumé.

idioms.def_en: something past that no longer matters
idioms.ex_en: Forget it, that's water under the bridge.
Chandler couldn't keep a straight face.
Sorry to rain on your parade, Joey.

phrasal.ex_en: Let's hold off on telling Monica.
phrasal.scene_ko: 비밀을 아직 말하지 않기로 하는 상황

phrasal.def_en: to end up in a situation
phrasal.ex_en: We always wind up at Central Perk.
phrasal.ex_ko: 우리는 늘 결국 센트럴 퍼크에 있게 돼.

phrasal.def_en: to get rid of a feeling or problem
phrasal.ex_en: Ross couldn't shake off the bad mood.
Don't brush off what Phoebe said.
Monica told Joey off for the mess.
phrasal.ex_ko: 모니카는 어질러 놓은 일로 조이를 꾸짖었다.

phrasal.ex_en: Rachel will look into other job options.

phrasal.def_en: to cancel plans at the last minute
phrasal.ex_en: Don't bail on me tonight, Chandler.
phrasal.ex_ko: 오늘 밤 나 펑크 내지 마, 챈들러.

phrasal.def_en: to recover quickly after a problem
phrasal.ex_en: Joey always bounces back from bad news.
phrasal.ex_ko: 조이는 나쁜 소식에서도 늘 금방 회복한다.
phrasal.scene_ko: 낙천적인 조이가 금방 기운을 차리는 상황

phrasal.def_en: to start to cry a little
phrasal.ex_en: Phoebe teared up during her song.
We should head out before the rain starts.
phrasal.ex_ko: 비 오기 전에 나서는 게 좋겠어.
